Eight of twelve results are BLUETTI's own store pages (several duplicates) that list prices and specs but never compare the two units or address home backup, three are dead flyer PDFs, and one is unreadable. The only page that actually answers the question is a single niche review (backuppowerhub) comparing specs from the Apex 200 launch with no checkable testing. A focused Apex 200 vs Apex 300 home-backup page with a clear pick, 240V/expansion/price-per-kWh comparison and current codes would be the strongest result here.
